menu_options.account: Sign in with the app account

account.title: Sign in with the app account
account.description: Read-only cloud telemetry. The password is hashed locally and only the digest is stored. It is used to recover the session automatically when the refresh token expires.

token.title: Use an existing session token
token.description: Paste an access token and, if available, its matching refresh token from your own Solar of Things app. Nothing is written back to the inverter.

reauth_account.title: Sign in again
reauth_account.description: The stored session could not be renewed. Enter the account password to obtain a new session.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the cloud session
reauth_confirm.description: The previous session can no longer be renewed. Paste a fresh access token and its matching refresh token from your app.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot retrieve fresh telemetry. Check the device ID, credentials and cloud connectivity.
